title: One Acorn Started THIS?!
description: An original 41-second, no-dialogue woodland chain-reaction comedy. One runaway acorn sets off a spectacular surprise for a tiny fox.
hook: Frame one: a tiny fox drops an acorn directly toward camera; its impact starts a runaway chain reaction. By 2.6 seconds the viewer must wonder what the machine will trigger.
script: A fox drops an acorn; the acorn tips a pinecone seesaw. Three walnuts race through log grooves. A springy mushroom fires a crimson leaf. The leaf tips a bark seesaw, sending dew pearls through leaf channels. Dew vibrates a harmless silk web and releases berries into a hollow-log xylophone. A hidden squirrel helps the last acorn lift a counterweight. A circular autumn-leaf garland unfolds and crowns the fox. The fox's happy tail flick tips a second acorn into the identical opening frame.

character_bible.fox: Tiny rust-orange fox, cream muzzle and chest, white-tipped fluffy tail, dark expressive eyes, forest-green neckerchief, no changes across shots.
character_bible.squirrel: Tiny brown squirrel with a striped tail and small blue acorn pouch; glimpse only at 12.3s, full appearance at 27.5s.
character_bible.world: One geographically continuous golden-hour autumn clearing: hollow oak center-left, mossy fallen log right, stump foreground, leaf-channel water run, pinecone spiral and branch garland all visible in coherent relative positions.
character_bible.props: Exactly two identifiable acorns: first triggers chain; second is loop reset. Three walnuts, one crimson maple leaf, five dew drops, red berries, bark seesaw, harmless unoccupied silk web, hollow log xylophone, leaf garland.
character_bible.visual_style: Warm stylized 3D film with tactile fur, amber backlight, gentle depth of field, realistic gravity and contact physics; no static tableaux.
